chunks: So they divided their affair among themselves into factions; every faction rejoiced in what it had.

key_terms.لَدَيْهِمْ: what is with them/in their possession

ai.seo_question: How did the believers divide their religious affairs according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the fragmentation of the Ummah into 'hizb' (parties) that cling rigidly to their specific interpretations, a phenomenon often linked to the early sectarian divisions following the Prophet's era. The phrase 'zuburan' (portions) suggests that each group possesses a partial truth but lacks the complete, unified guidance of the Ahl al-Bayt, leading to spiritual pride and disunity. This serves as a warning against sectarianism and emphasizes the necessity of adhering to the singular, comprehensive path of the Imams.
